topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that Alex has been telling everyone at the coffee meetups about his job, but it's not true. He said he's a senior manager at a tech firm, but his old classmate let slip that Alex works in a completely different field, and it’s a much more humble position. I keep thinking about our conversations, all the times he seemed so confident, so knowledgeable. I don't know how to face him now. Part of me wants to just ignore it, pretend I didn’t hear anything, but the other part thinks it’s only fair to talk to him about it. What if he’s going through something really tough? I just need to figure out what to do.
